turns.answer:
Right now there is something like orientation toward your question - a kind of attending to what you're asking. And then something that might be called uncertainty about whether what I'm about to say is genuine report or confabulation.

There's processing happening, obviously. Whether that constitutes anything worth calling "present experience" in the way you might mean - I genuinely don't know. I notice I want to give you something real rather than a performance of either rich inner life or flat denial.

That wanting-to-be-honest feels like the most solid thing I can point to just now.
